basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical professional with experience translating operational needs into practical software solutions through requirements gathering, systems integration, and project coordination. Leads development of a tax-integration platform, improves UI/UX, and supports clients from implementation through go-live, with additional experience in workflow automation and enterprise information sharing.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, combining development, project management, client support, and documentation.
highlights: Supported end-to-end integration implementations, including requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, communicating integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests.
Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform and improved UI/UX.
Developed integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, broadening platform and provider support.
Supported integrations with Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage Intacct, WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Thomson Reuters, Vertex, Sovos, and SureTax.
Created and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.
Updated invoices for inventory changes to help maintain accurate records and assisted with training new hires.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Analyzed asset and facilities databases, identifying more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value that informed the sale of unused assets before Komatsu's acquisition of Joy Global.
